name: Kotoba Language
description: Kotoba Language is an adult language school at Scheepmakerspassage 14, Rotterdam, founded in 2016. It teaches English, Dutch, French, German, Mandarin and Japanese to new arrivals and cross-border teams, in classes of at most 8. This block theme opens on a split photograph-and-text screen with an oversized cropped wordmark, and presents three unequal pathways with mirrored curved arcs around a circular photograph, a CEFR hairline scale, circular teacher portraits, a fee table in EUR and learner stories. EB Garamond for headings, Source Sans 3 for reading. Sample content in English.
